title: Calibrating first-principles lattice thermal conductivity to experiment: a curated half-Heusler dataset and a validated transfer function
description:
A curated, provenance-tracked corpus of half-Heusler lattice thermal conductivity in which laboratory measurements and first-principles transport calculations are tiered separately and never pooled, together with a two-parameter transfer function mapping a published Boltzmann-transport calculation onto the experimental scale.

Published transport calculations exceed measured lattice thermal conductivity by a median factor of 1.55. Within a domain of applicability declared in advance, the correction places 86.8 % of 38 held-out compounds within a factor of two of measurement, under leave-one-chemistry-out validation in which the compound's entire chemistry is withheld from the regression model and from the calibration alike.

The archive contains the curated corpus, the prediction list with its refusals, the five model seeds behind every seed-averaged figure, and the code that regenerates every figure and number in the paper. Code is MIT licensed; the curated data are CC BY 4.0. Upstream databases (Starrydata2, AFLOW, Materials Project, JARVIS, OQMD, COD) are fetched by the scripts rather than redistributed here — see LICENSE-DATA.
